title: Energy Dissipation Analysis of Implicit-Explicit Linear Multistep Methods for Gradient Flows Using General Multipliers
summary: A unified framework is proposed to establish the energy dissipation of implicit-explicit linear multistep methods (IMEX-LMMs) for gradient flows, based on general multipliers that are linear combinations of first-order differences of numerical solutions. A generalized Dahlquist's theory is developed to establish the energy dissipation of IMEX-LMMs. It is shown that given an IMEX-LMM, to find a multiplier ensuring the energy dissipation is relaxed to solve a linear programming that can be easily solved.
